context.description: The summary is written even when a turn is in flight or the run was cancelled

evidence.trustReason: Independent review after 688450d923 (test-only change). Read the Gherkin, git show 688450d923, the whole test, and supervise/run.ts, harness.ts, command.ts job, recorder.ts, workers.summary, SessionPrompt.say. Lease-wait soundness: the lease is freed only by the supervisor finish step (after the run actor left active and the status writer ended, then summarizing follows), by closing on a failed start, or by the job scope finalizer, which runs last, after the cancel finalizer (untilClosed or the 5 s deadline plus removeRun). In the run-ends case no cancel occurs, so a free lease means the summary step is next (latestRun already holds S1-S12 scenario.verified, so the wait is the lease alone); ended(slice) then asserts the stored slice folds to done, and the Recorder stores before it applies, so the stored slice equals the folded actor. In the cancel case a deadline-path release drops the summary, which the summary-log and single-summary checks fail. A not-final machine fails ended(); it cannot pass. GIVEN: inFlight resumes the stored slice via /task, holds the S4 judge, holds the root QUESTION turn, asserts the QUESTION model hit and session busy. WHEN: three tests, run ends (judge released), user abort (SessionPrompt.cancel), job cancel (BackgroundJob.cancel, forked). THEN: in the run-ends and cancel cases no summary and no summary log during a 1 s / 0.5 s window with the turn held and the run final with a free lease (run-ends also asserts the supervisor still running); after the turn: summary log empty, exactly one OUTCOME summary, parentID equals the run header, last message after the question. AND: a later LATER prompt returns LATER_ANSWER, a new model hit holds LATER, still one summary. Rerun: 3 pass, 0 fail, 50 expects, 32.4 s at load 26. Residual: the waiting window is time-based, unchanged from the prior trusted version.

Scenario: UI8 The summary is written even when a turn is in flight or the run was cancelled

    When the run ends, or the user aborts the root session, or the run is cancelled

    And a later user prompt in the root session still runs a model turn
